daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot right now. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your spiritual GPS today. Channel that emotional intelligence into something creative or meaningful.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the effort you're putting in, even if you haven't said much. Your energy speaks louder than words today. If you're single, that confidence is genuinely magnetic.
daily.career: Your ability to read the room is your superpower today. Use it to navigate conversations and collaborations smoothly. Small wins are adding up more than you realize.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentle movement and rest. Whether that's a walk, stretching, or just being present with yourself—listen to what feels good. Mental clarity follows physical ease.

weekly.overview: This week invites you to lean into your intuition—it's literally screaming for your attention. Mercury's movement is softening your communication style, making it easier to express what's been bottled up. Trust the gut feeling that keeps showing up.
weekly.love: Your emotional frequency is magnetic right now. If you've been holding back, this is the week to be vulnerable in the ways that feel right. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy. Taken? Deep conversations are on the menu.
weekly.career: Your creative momentum is real this week. Channel that visionary Cancer energy into projects that actually excite you. Small wins are building momentum—don't sleep on them. Your instincts about what needs to happen next are chef's kiss accurate.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more rest and hydration than usual. Listen to it. Movement that feels nourishing (not punishing) is calling your name. Your nervous system appreciates slower, grounding activities this week.
